column7: BulkRotateSecrets performed no permission check in core (requireActorActive only), so any active principal, a project viewer included, could rotate a project's secrets through a direct core call while REST refused them at the secrets.write@project route gate. Core now calls requireScopedGate(secrets.write, project) after the request-shape checks and before any secret is listed or loaded; a refusal rotates and audits nothing. Actor 0 (internal pseudo-actor) unchanged. Defence in depth: REST already refused and there is no gRPC method.
